image_description: Two baby bibs lying flat on a textured beige fabric surface. The top bib is light mint green with a rounded neck opening, featuring three small square patch pockets with plaid patterns and button details. The bottom bib is larger, made of multi-colored plaid fabric (red, green, yellow, blue) with white lace trim along the edges. Both appear to be fabric construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mint green bib has a rounded rectangular shape; the plaid bib has a broader rounded/shield-like shape. Both fit the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both bibs exhibit a distinct curved neckline designed to fit under a chin.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surfaces are matte and non-reflective, consistent with fabric bibs rather than glossy plastic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface may be plain patterned or printed with designs.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity of the objects as bibs and distinguish from similar garments like aprons or smocks.
To verify the structural integrity of the lace trim and ensure no melting or fusion artifacts exist between the layered bibs and the background.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the fabric weave and stitching consistency which are common failure points in AI-generated textiles.

focus_areas: Stitching consistency around the neck holes and pockets
Logical attachment of the patch pockets to the main body
Texture coherence of the plaid pattern across folds
Boundary sharpness of the white lace trim
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the patch pockets on the mint bib appear physically attached or if they float/fuse into the fabric. Check if the plaid pattern distorts unnaturally around the curves of the bib. Ensure the lace trim has consistent topology without breaking or merging into the background.
